title: cartiera arguta
intro: Cartiera arguta, commonly known as Argus, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cartiera arguta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
